messages:
sam_support: Escalating Zendesk #CS-9182 — Acme reported sudden 401s on SSO after IdP rotated keys an hour ago. They say users hit the app, redirect to IdP, then back to our ACS and we return 401. Ticket attached with SAMLResponse. @priya_engineer can you take lead?

priya_engineer: on it. quick ask: did Acme change ACS hostname or proxy recently? any trailing-slash rewriting?

sam_support: Customer says no infra change. They gave IdP metadata URL and the SAMLResponse. metadata: https://idp.acme.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml. They mention the IdP rotation included adding a new ECDSA key alongside RSA.

priya_engineer: fetching metadata now, will paste snippet.

priya_engineer: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme.example">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <KeyInfo>...RSA key...</KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <KeyInfo>...ECDSA key...</KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
    <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://idp.acme.example/sso"/>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

priya_engineer: Our logs show assertion validation failing with InvalidRecipient and Signature verification failing intermittently. Copied from runtime:```
ERROR saml.validate: InvalidRecipient: expected https://app.redwood.example/sso/acs, got https://app.redwood.example/sso/acs/
ERROR saml.verify: Signature verification failed: no matching cert in chain (depth 1)
```

jordan_sre: two things to check: (1) recipient canonicalization / trailing slash mismatch, (2) cert chain verification for ECDSA on our runtime (some older openssl stacks need full chain ordering).

luis_devex: also saw this: Acme is behind a proxy that rewrites Host header to the internal hostname (app.internal.local) before forwarding to our ACS endpoint; if our ACS is strict on Recipient it will fail. Can customer try hitting our canonical ACS host directly (bypassing proxy) once for a repro?

sam_support: Customer tried bypass and still saw 401s. They pasted base64 SAMLResponse — I decoded and saw Recipient set to https://app.redwood.example/sso/acs (no trailing slash). Our staging expects trailing slash.

priya_engineer: hmm we accept both normally, but we had a recent security tighten that compares exact Recipient in SAMLAssertion to configured ACS in SP metadata. There was also a bug in metadata refresh where we cached only the first KeyDescriptor — which explains signature verify failures when IdP rotated and re-ordered keys. Repro steps I used locally:
1) curl metadata -> save
2) run our saml-tool validate with that metadata + SAMLResponse
```bash
curl -sS https://idp.acme.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml -o meta.xml
./saml-tool validate --meta meta.xml --response response.b64 --sp-acs https://app.redwood.example/sso/acs/
```

priya_engineer: output shows: `Warning: metadata key order changed; using first signing key only` then `Signature verification failed`.

jordan_sre: ok that matches. Two-pronged fix: quick mitigation — enable relaxed recipient matching on the customer's SP config (accept with/without trailing slash) and enable metadata refresh to prefer a key by KeyName thumbprint rather than position. Long term — patch metadata loader to retain all KeyDescriptors and pick by signature algorithm/KeyInfo match.

sam_support: I pushed mitigation steps to ticket and asked Acme to toggle relaxed matching. They said they'd prefer we fix on our side.

luis_devex: rolling a fast patch to metadata loader now. Deploy bot will run canary to staging first. @eng-deploy-bot kick the canary.

eng-deploy-bot: deploy-requested: canary deploy for commit 7a2f9c2 (metadata-loader: preserve all KeyDescriptor entries + match by KeyInfo thumbprint). Started pipeline.

priya_engineer: while deploy runs, for customer immediate workaround: they uploaded IdP metadata to their portal and added an alternate ACS with trailing slash https://app.redwood.example/sso/acs/ — they confirm sign-in success for one user.

jordan_sre: after canary passes, we'll promote to prod. Also adding unit tests for ECDSA chain validation ordering. Add note to run `openssl verify -CAfile fullchain.pem cert.pem` to detect chain ordering problems.

eng-deploy-bot: canary succeeded (staging). running production rollout.

eng-deploy-bot: rollout complete. version=2026.3.51

priya_engineer: patch verified in prod logs: metadata loader now keeps both KeyDescriptor entries and signature verification picks correct key. Also relaxed recipient compare is toggled only for Acme (temporary). Logs show successful Verify and AcceptedRecipient for several recent attempts.

sam_support: updated Zendesk ticket with root cause and timeline, next steps for Acme: keep alternate ACS entry while they coordinate IdP cleanup, and confirm rotation testing plan. Marking as resolved but leave follow-up task to ensure we don't enable relaxed globally.

luis_devex: created a follow-up GH issue #1428 to add strictness tests and a config flag comment.

sam_support: thanks all — quick and clean. :thumbsup:
